_comment: The data pack regions. Bounds are minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat (WGS84). Basemaps are cut per region so a phone installs only what it needs; routing and search are built once for the whole area (nys: New York plus northern New Jersey) so cross-region trips work. core/packs Regions.kt mirrors this file and a unit test keeps the two in step. 'area' (optional) is a polygon of [lon,lat] points: where a point belongs to the region when its box overlaps others; njn's box takes in Staten Island, Rockland and the Bronx, its area is only the New Jersey side of the state line (approximate, within about a kilometre). 'sources' (optional) says which Geofabrik extracts a region is built from: the default is the New York extract cut to the region's own bounds; each entry maps an extract to null (whole), 'self' (cut to this region's bounds) or another region's id (cut to that region's bounds), and several entries are merged (see pipeline/lib/common.sh clip_extract).
